name: Natsuki Kenichi
description: Natsuki Kenichi is the father of Natsuki Subaru and husband of Natsuki Naoko. A charismatic, athletic, and universally admired man in his neighborhood in modern-day Japan, Subaru spent years trying to emulate him. He appears prominently in Subaru's First Trial in the Sanctuary during Arc 4, helping Subaru reconcile his insecurities and move forward.
